verdict.rationale: Customer.io's core platform natively supports recurring/triggered workflows (automations triggered by events/segments, chained Wait Until delays, scheduled broadcasts) and docs claim AI can 'build automations' via the CLI/MCP, with MCP able to list active automations. However, there is no concrete evidence of an AI agent actually creating or scheduling a new recurring workflow end-to-end (writes/deletes require separate approval, and only read/list and draft-email examples are shown). missing for 10: a documented example of AI creating/editing a recurring automation via MCP or CLI, independent confirmation of AI-driven automation authoring succeeding.
